top_signals.title: CFTC Clears Faster Payouts for Tipster Awards Under $5 Million
top_signals.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission plans to automatically award successful whistleblowers 30% of any enforcement penalties collected if a tipster is due to receive $5 million or less, the agency said Friday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: White House Weighs Defense Production Act as U.S. Refineries Maxed Out
top_signals.summary: The White House is considering using the Defense Production Act to add U.S. refining capacity, with American refineries already running at 98% capacity and diesel prices above $6 per gallon for the first time. The proposal was discussed during President Donald Trump’s recent meeting with nearly a dozen U.S. refiners, according to Reuters. No decision has been made, and discussions are expected to continue.
